query_facts.statement_family: apply: remove obsolete retailer-scoped GTIN identifiers
query_facts.predicate: retailer_assertion identifiers without a live retailer_identifier_assertions evidence row
query_facts.sql: DELETE FROM product_identifiers identifier USING makolet_affected_gtins affected WHERE identifier.kind = 'gtin' AND identifier.normalized_value = affected.gtin AND identifier.issuer_retailer_id IS NOT NULL AND identifier.validation_method = 'retailer_assertion' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM retailer_identifier_assertions assertion JOIN retailer_items evidence_item ON evidence_item.id = assertion.retailer_item_id WHERE assertion.kind = 'gtin' AND assertion.normalized_value = identifier.normalized_value AND assertion.superseded_at IS NULL AND evidence_item.retailer_id = identifier.issuer_retailer_id)
query_facts.progress_visibility: PostgreSQL has no pg_stat_progress view for DELETE; per-table statistics remained uncommitted inside the active transaction
query_facts.explain_analyze_at_one_million: not run because it would perturb the acceptance workload

environment.storage: dedicated WSL2 ext4 filesystem on E: with approximately 956 GiB free before the run

termination.method: pg_terminate_backend limited to PID 296 with application_name makolet-scale-benchmark
termination.reason: the initial apply could not complete within a useful acceptance window because one cleanup statement remained CPU-active for more than ten minutes
termination.rollback: connection termination rolled back the active apply transaction
termination.schema_cleanup: BenchmarkSandbox finally block dropped only schema makolet_benchmark

unmeasured: full-scale query and apply EXPLAIN plans
